episode_notes: A romantic comedy web series where rich guy Abhi hides his wealthy background under the alias 'Vijay' to work in a cafe and stay close to his crush Meera. Complications escalate when his childhood friend Harshitha, whom his father wants him to marry, tracks him down and repeatedly endangers his cover story. The climactic cliffhanger of Abhi's father barging into the cafe looking for him would spoil the episode's ending.

Actually మా parents మమ్మల్ని చదివించుకు ముందు చాలా rich ఉండేవాళ్ళం. మమ్మల్ని చదివించాకే poor అయిపోయాం. ఏంటి?
